articles.body:
Radio 5 Live , · 21 Oct 2026 , · 48 mins

Aaron Paul and Jobi McAnuff are joined by Lyle Taylor to discuss the latest in the EFL. Sheffield United legend Billy Sharp joins the pod following his retirement after a 22-year-long career. He tells us what made him an EFL bagsman and how he knew it was time to hang up the boots. Burnley haven't won at home in the league for an entire year- how real is the threat of back-to-back relegation? What's the root of their problem? Plus, there's been a sacking in League Two: having been let go by Crawley Town, what next for Colin Kazim-Richards? articles.title: The 13 best toothpastes for whitening and healthy gums, according to dentists
articles.summary: Dentists share the best toothpastes for whitening and cavity protection from trusted brands like Crest, Colgate, Sensodyne and Parodontax.
articles.body: Choosing the right toothpaste is an essential part of oral hygiene, but the process can be confusing. All toothpastes clean teeth, but you may also need to address concerns like reducing sensitivity, whitening, and improving gum health. I've been reporting on oral care for years now — at this point I practically have dentists on speed dial. To find the best toothpastes, I talked to dentists and used their guidance to round up options made with fluoride from brands like Crest, Colgate and Sensodyne. Many of the toothpastes we recommend have the American Dental Association’s Seal of Acceptance, and the NBC Selected staff also tried a handful of them. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best toothpastes for adults Best toothpaste for all-around protection In addition to offering cavity, gum and enamel protection, this toothpaste removes plaque buildup and tartar. It’s also sensitive teeth friendly, according to the brand, and made with hydrated silica, a gently abrasive ingredient that scrubs surface stains off teeth. Plus, it comes in a recyclable carton. Best basic toothpaste Consider this Colgate option if you’re looking for a basic fluoride toothpaste and don’t have specific dental needs. It protects against cavities, thoroughly cleans teeth and freshens breath, according to the brand. Best plaque-removing toothpaste Plaque is a collection of bacteria, food and other debris that sticks to your teeth, experts told me. Without intervention, it can lead to issues like gingivitis, also known as early gum disease, as well as swollen, bleeding gums. Parodontax’s toothpaste is designed to break down and remove plaque, and kill bacteria on teeth, according to the brand. Best foaming toothpaste Colgate’s Total Plaque Pro-Release Toothpaste won a NBC Selected Wellness Award and our reviewers say it left their teeth feeling clean and fresh. As you brush, the paste, which offers antibacterial protection, turns into a thick, foamy later. The foam dissolves plaque and lifts it off teeth, especially along the gum line, according to the brand. Best toothpaste for sensitive teeth Dentin is the soft inner part of your teeth, and if it’s exposed due to enamel erosion, you may experience sensitivity to hot and cold food or beverages, experts told me. Sensodyne’s toothpaste, an NBC Selected Wellness Award winner, contains potassium nitrate to help calm the nerves in your teeth and make them less sensitive, according to the brand. Best whitening toothpaste for sensitive teeth This Sensodyne toothpaste is also a NBC Selected Wellness Award winner. It gently whitens teeth by removing stains and makes them less sensitive thanks to the potassium nitrate it’s formulated with. The toothpaste, whose tube, cap and carton are recyclable, also remineralizes enamel to strengthen it, according to the brand. Best pH-balanced toothpaste CloSYS’s toothpaste offers cavity and enamel protection. It has a pH-balanced formula, which neutralizes plaque bacteria to create a non-acidic environment in the mouth and prevent bad breath, according to the brand. Best whitening toothpaste Nu Skin’s whitening toothpaste is a NBC Selected Wellness Award winner. It uses hydrated silica to remove surface stains from teeth, as well as aluminum hydroxide, a mild abrasive, according to the brand. Best subscription toothpaste Quip automatically delivers toothpaste to your door every three months when you sign up for its subscription. That means you won’t have to remember to buy a new tube when you run out. The toothpaste comes in a recyclable tube and it’s also available for one-time purchases. Best gel toothpaste Gel toothpastes typically have a smooth texture and don’t get as foamy as thick pastes, experts told me. Aim’s gel toothpaste helps prevent cavities, tooth decay and acid erosion while strengthening enamel and removing plaque, according to the brand. Best natural toothpaste for sensitive teeth Many toothpastes for sensitive teeth contain potassium nitrate, but AloeSense’s toothpaste is a natural alternative. It’s made with aloe vera and allantoin, ingredients that naturally soothe sensitive teeth, according to the brand. Aloe vera works to moisturize the mouth, while allantoin gently cleans the teeth and gums. Best toothpaste with baking soda Baking soda, also known as sodium bicarbonate, is the key ingredient in this toothpaste. It neutralizes acids in the mouth and gently removes surface stains from teeth to whiten them over time, according to the brand. The smooth toothpaste gets foamy while you brush to help clean along the gum line as well as between teeth. Best toothpaste for enamel repair Made By Dentists' toothpaste has ingredients that help remineralize lost enamel to make it stronger and harder. Hydroxyapatite, for example, is a compound that's naturally found in enamel, and it penetrates teeth to remineralize them from within, according to the brand. This toothpaste is also made with potassium nitrate, which can help reduce tooth pain and sensitivity. How I picked the best toothpastes To pull together our list of recommendations, I kept these expert-guided factors in mind: American Dental Association Seal of Acceptance: Oral care products like toothpaste, floss, mouthwash and manual and electric toothbrushes can earn the ADA’s Seal of Acceptance. In order to do so, brands submit scientific evidence showing that their products meet specific safety and efficacy criteria, which the ADA evaluates. Each ADA-approved toothpaste contains fluoride and is not made with flavoring agents like sugar that can cause or contribute to tooth decay. This doesn’t mean toothpaste without the ADA’s Seal of Acceptance are ineffective — it just means brands have not voluntarily submitted their products for the ADA to review.Fluoride: All of the experts I spoke to recommend using a toothpaste made with fluoride, a cavity-fighting ingredient. Sodium fluoride, stannous fluoride and sodium are three types of fluoride that may be listed on toothpaste ingredient labels, all of which are equally effective.Sodium lauryl sulfate: Sodium lauryl sulfate, commonly referred to as SLS, is an ingredient found in many toothpastes that acts as a detergent for your teeth, says Dr. Lana Rozenberg, dentist and founder of Rozenberg Dental NYC. It’s also what makes some toothpastes foamy. People can be sensitive to SLS, so if you are, look for an SLS-free option.Texture: Toothpastes usually have a gel or paste texture. Gel toothpastes have a smooth, non-foamy texture and are typically not abrasive or gritty. Paste toothpastes tend to be more foamy, thicker, grittier and solid in color, says Rozenberg.Specialized options: Beyond protecting teeth from cavities, toothpaste can offer additional benefits like teeth whitening or enamel repair. Some are also designed for those with sensitive teeth. A toothpaste’s packaging and label will say what it specifically targets, so think about whether that aligns with your teeth’s needs.Flavor: This is entirely a personal preference. Just be sure that your toothpaste doesn’t contain flavoring agents like sugar that cause or contribute to tooth decay. All ADA-approved options don’t, so if you’re unsure about a toothpaste, it’s best to go with one that earned the organization’s Seal of Acceptance, experts say. What ingredients are in toothpaste? Reading a toothpaste’s ingredient label can tell you a lot about the benefits it offers and what specific needs it targets. Beyond fluoride and SLS, we asked experts to define some common ingredients you may see and what they do — they’re listed below. If you have any questions about how these ingredients relate to your teeth specifically, consult your dentist since they know your oral health status the best, says Dr. Edmond Hewlett, a professor at the UCLA School of Dentistry. Xylitol: Xylitol is a sugar alcohol, but unlike sugar that’s in sweets, it does not contribute to cavities and tooth decay. In fact, it does the exact opposite — it prevents decay by reducing the rate at which cavities form, says Rozenberg.Hydrated silica: Hydrated silica is usually responsible for the gritty, slightly abrasive texture in toothpaste. A more gritty toothpaste helps remove plaque and surface stains without damaging the teeth or gums. Other abrasive agents you’ll commonly find in toothpaste are calcium carbonate, hydrated aluminum oxides, magnesium carbonate, phosphate sales and silicates, according to the ADA.Potassium nitrate: Often found in toothpaste for sensitive teeth, potassium nitrate helps block the transmission of pain signals from the nerves within teeth to your brain, says Rozenberg.Sodium bicarbonate: Also known as baking soda, this helps remove plaque from teeth and other debris from the mouth.Essential oils: Some essential oils are considered antibacterial, like thymol, menthol, eucalyptol, and methyl salicylate, says Rozenberg. They can also reduce plaque and gingivitis. Zinc chloride: Zinc chloride is an antimicrobial agent in toothpaste. It helps prevent gingivitis, reduce tartar and eliminate bad breathHumectants: Humectants like glycerol, propylene glycol and sorbitol minimize water loss in the toothpaste, according to the ADA.Thickening agents and binders: Ingredients like mineral or seaweed colloids, natural gums and synthetic cellulose thicken toothpaste and act as stabilizers.Peroxide: If you’re shopping for a whitening toothpaste, look for those that contain hydrogen peroxide and/or carbamide peroxide, both of which help lighten stains. Meet our dentistry experts At NBC Selected, we work with experts with specialized knowledge and authority based on relevant training and/or experience. We also ensure that all expert advice and recommendations are made independently and with no undisclosed financial conflicts of interest. Dr. Lana Rozenberg, DDS, is the founder of Rozenberg Dental NYC.Dr. Edmond Hewlett, DDS, is a professor at the UCLA School of Dentistry, where he also serves as the associate dean for equity, diversity and inclusion.Dr. Kate Zoumboukos, DMD, practices dentistry at SW Austin Dental in Texas. She also participates in humanitarian dental mission trips and routinely speaks to local schools about the dental profession. Why trust NBC Selected? I'm a reporter at NBC Selected who writes about dental care, including stories on electric toothbrushes, different types of toothpaste, at-home whitening treatments, floss and water flossers. For this article, I interviewed three experts about how to shop for toothpaste and rounded up options that met their guidance. Catch up on NBC Selected’s in-depth coverage of tech and tools, wellness and more, and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok to stay up to date.

articles.title: Greve de ônibus em Taubaté termina após pagamento de salários | G1
articles.standfirst: Movimento começou após atraso no pagamento de adiantamento salarial e afeta 32 linhas operadas pela ABC Transportes.
articles.summary: Motoristas da ABC Transportes encerraram a greve de ônibus em Taubaté nesta quarta-feira (21) após o depósito dos salários, normalizando a circulação das 32 linhas municipais.
articles.body:
Ônibus voltam a circular após pagamento de vale salarial encerrar paralisação em Taubaté — Foto: Gabriel Guimarães/TV Vanguarda

A paralisação dos motoristas do transporte público de Taubaté foi encerrada na tarde desta quarta-feira (21). Às 14h10, o sindicato da categoria informou ao repórter Gabriel Guimarães, da Rede Vanguarda, que os salários foram depositados e que os ônibus já estão liberados para circular.

Até às 14h, nenhum ônibus havia saído da garagem da ABC Transportes, e as 32 linhas operadas pela empresa estavam paralisadas, segundo apuração da repórter Laurene Santos, da Rede Vanguarda .

Segundo o Sindicato dos Condutores do Vale do Paraíba, a paralisação deve continuar até que todos os funcionários recebam os valores. Veja abaixo o que houve na paralisação:

Segundo o sindicato, os trabalhadores reivindicam o pagamento do adiantamento salarial, que deveria ter sido depositado na terça-feira (20). O pagamento é feito em duas parcelas, nos dias 5 e 20 de cada mês.

A paralisação afetou 32 linhas de ônibus operadas pela ABC Transportes, responsável pelo transporte público municipal.

O movimento começou por volta das 4h30 desta quarta-feira (21).

De acordo com o Sindicato dos Condutores do Vale do Paraíba, cerca de 200 funcionários participaram da mobilização. Desse total, aproximadamente 120 são motoristas, além de trabalhadores de outros setores da empresa.

Ônibus parados na garagem durante paralisação em Taubaté. — Foto: Reprodução/Rede Vanguarda

Segundo a apuração da TV Vanguarda , não havia ônibus circulando para atender os passageiros, nem mesmo em caráter emergencial durante a paralisação.

A Prefeitura de Taubaté informou que realizou, às 8h desta quarta-feira (21), o repasse dos recursos destinados ao adiantamento salarial dos motoristas. A administração municipal aguardava a confirmação do crédito nas contas dos trabalhadores e a retomada integral do transporte coletivo.

Paralisação impede saída de ônibus da garagem e afeta transporte público em Taubaté, SP — Foto: Reprodução/TV Vanguarda

Em nota, a Busvale, Associação das Empresas de Transporte Coletivo de Passageiros do Vale do Paraíba, informou que a ABC Transportes comunicou aos funcionários, na terça-feira (20), que não conseguiria realizar o pagamento do adiantamento na data prevista por causa de dificuldades financeiras momentâneas.

A empresa afirmou que esperava regularizar a situação com a entrada de recursos.

Por que a paralisação continuou mesmo após o repasse da Prefeitura?

Embora a administração municipal tenha informado que fez o repasse dos recursos pela manhã, os trabalhadores ainda aguardavam a confirmação do pagamento em suas contas. Segundo o sindicato, a mobilização continuaria até que todos recebessem os valores.

O que diz a Prefeitura sobre a paralisação

A administração municipal afirmou que a paralisação começou sem aviso prévio e sem a manutenção dos serviços indispensáveis à população, conforme previsto em contrato. A Prefeitura informou que o caso será encaminhado à Procuradoria-Geral do Município para avaliação de medidas cabíveis.

A Prefeitura também declarou que, em 2026, houve aumento dos valores destinados ao transporte público em decorrência de um aditivo contratual firmado em 2023. O acordo prorrogou a concessão até 2034 e alterou o modelo de remuneração da empresa, que passou a considerar os quilômetros rodados, em vez do número de passageiros transportados.

Segundo a administração municipal, há tratativas com a concessionária sobre questões relacionadas ao contrato, com o objetivo de garantir a regularidade e a continuidade do transporte público.

Em nota, a associação afirmou que acompanha a situação e considera importante o diálogo entre as partes para buscar uma solução que minimize os impactos à população e permita o restabelecimento da operação o mais breve possível.

A entidade também informou que a ABC Transportes havia comunicado aos funcionários as dificuldades financeiras momentâneas e a expectativa de regularizar o pagamento nos dias seguintes, conforme a entrada de recursos prevista.

articles.title: Autoridades dos EUA temem interferência de Trump nas midterms | G1
articles.standfirst: Presidente norte-americano tem pressionado cada vez mais o sistema eleitoral dos EUA para evitar que o partido republicano perca o controle do Congresso nas eleições legislativas, que estão marcadas para 3 de novembro.
articles.summary: Presidente norte-americano tem pressionado cada vez mais o sistema eleitoral dos EUA para evitar que o partido republicano perca o controle do Congresso nas eleições legislativas, que estão marcadas para 3 de novembro.
articles.body:
Donald Trump fala a jornalistas ao deixar a Casa Branca, em Washington, em 13 de outubro de 2026. — Foto: Kevin Lamarque/Reuters

Autoridades de segurança dos Estados Unidos estão temendo cada vez mais que o presidente Donald Trump interfira nas eleições de meio de mandato —as midterms—, ao mesmo tempo que trumpistas do movimento MAGA têm falado cada vez mais abertamente sobre lei marcial , segundo reportagens da mídia norte-americana.

Segundo fontes ouvidas pelo jornal "The Washington Post", um pequeno grupo de autoridades de segurança nacional dos EUA vem aconselhando discretamente governos estaduais e parlamentares do Congresso sobre como se preparar para a possibilidade do governo Trump tentar interferir nas eleições legislativas.

Esse movimento decorre de um temor gerado por falas cada vez mais inflamatórias e de tom autoritário feitas por Trump sobre o pleito. Em comícios e pronunciamentos nas últimas semanas, o presidente norte-americano:

disse que "os EUA vão queimar como a França" caso os democratas saiam vencedores do pleito;

prometeu US$ 5 mil para cada cidadão caso seu partido, o republicano, mantenha o controle do Congresso após a eleição;

afirmou que o sistema de votação está fraudado;

Somando-se ao cenário, ativistas do movimento MAGA ("Make America Great Again", ou "Façam os EUA grandes novamente", em português) próximos de Trump têm falado cada vez mais abertamente sobre pedir que ele instaure a lei marcial nos EUA sob a suposta alegação de que as eleições estariam sendo fraudadas , segundo o site Axios.

➡️ As midterms, previstas para ocorrer em 3 de novembro, são eleições legislativas de meio de mandato que renovarão toda a Câmara dos Deputados e um terço do Senado norte-americano, além de 36 cargos de governador estadual nos EUA. Leia mais sobre essas eleições aqui.

Alertas sobre possível interferência de Trump

O grupo que tem alertado políticos sobre uma possível interferência de Trump nas midterms inclui cerca de dez autoridades que trabalham no governo Trump e ex-integrantes do braço Executivo com experiência no Departamento de Guerra norte-americano, segundo o "Washington Post". Algumas delas já trabalharam no combate ao autoritarismo no exterior.

Essa iniciativa, segundo disseram os integrantes ao jornal, não seria motivada por um viés político, mas por uma preocupação crescente de que Trump possa prejudicar a democracia dos EUA ao comprometer a integridade da votação para manter o Partido Republicano no poder.

Midterms - Eleitora preenche cédula de votação em Harrisburg, na Pensilvânia (EUA) — Foto: REUTERS/Mike Segar

Ainda segundo o jornal, nos últimos meses, o grupo consultou autoridades de dez estados, incluindo governadores, responsáveis eleitorais e políticos da Câmara dos Deputados e do Senado de ambos os partidos políticos que também compartilham do temor de uma intervenção federal.

“Todos disseram que estão preocupados, mas não sabem o que fazer. O resultado que esperamos é que os estados estejam preparados para qualquer eventualidade, caso ela ocorra”, afirmou ao "Washington Post" um integrante do grupo ao descrever as reuniões com parlamentares.

A porta-voz da Casa Branca, Lauren Bis, rejeitou as preocupações levantadas pelo grupo e culpou os democratas por não apoiarem leis eleitorais mais rigorosas. Lauren disse também que o governo Trump "está tomando medidas para proteger" as eleições, incluindo o ""reforço da segurança da infraestrutura eleitoral e a proteção de eleitores vulneráveis contra fraudes e coerção”.

Ativistas MAGA pressionam Trump por lei marcial

Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, ao lado da ativista MAGA Tina Peters em encontro no Salão Oval, na Casa Branca, em 30 de junho de 2026. — Foto: Divulgação/Donald Trump no Truth Social

Ativistas MAGA mais radicais têm pressionado Trump para adotar medidas extraordinárias, incluindo instaurar lei marcial, caso considerem que as eleições de meio de mandato sejam “fraudadas”. Ao mesmo tempo, esses ativistas têm levantado cada vez mais teorias da conspiração que levariam a duvidar da integridade do pleito, reportou o Axios.

Segundo o site, a ativista eleitoral Tina Peters, uma das mais em evidência atualmente, reuniu-se com Trump neste mês. Tina foi condenada em 2024 a nove anos de prisão por crimes relacionados à violação de equipamentos eleitorais no estado do Colorado, mas foi libertada em junho deste ano após ter sua pena reduzida.

Tina ganhou notoriedade no mundo MAGA por ser uma das maiores vozes da narrativa de que as eleições presidenciais de 2020 foram fraudadas —algo que Trump alega sempre que tem a oportunidade.

Dias depois de deixar a prisão, Tina e seu advogado, Peter Ticktin, visitaram Trump na Casa Branca (veja na foto acima) . Ticktin (que não aparece na foto), inclusive, é amigo de infância do presidente.

Tina e Peter participaram de uma videoconferência no final de setembro para ativistas eleitorais MAGA na plataforma Rumble em que foram discutidas a integridade das eleições legislativas e medidas urgentes para enfrentar supostas ameaças. O Axios afirmou ter tido acesso à transmissão.

Durante a chamada, Ticktin afirmou que “teria de haver lei marcial caso ocorra [...] outra eleição fraudada”. Posteriormente, em fala ao Axios, ele disse que “provavelmente será necessário assumir o controle das cédulas e dos equipamentos eleitorais para garantir que possamos esclarecer tudo antes que qualquer outra coisa aconteça”.

Segundo o Axios, Tina Peters estaria promovendo um plano para a adoção de cédulas de papel preenchidas à mão e a recontagem manual de todos os votos sempre que viável para circunscrever as urnas eletrônicas em determinados estados.

Já Gregory Stenstrom, um ex-oficial da Marinha envolvido com irregularidades eleitorais na votação de 2020 na Pensilvânia, propôs na chamada do Rumble pedir que Trump invoque a Lei Nacional de Emergências para obrigar os estados a mudar a maneira como organizam as eleições, segundo o Axios.

articles.title: Especialistas da ONU questionam papel da Meta nas eleições no Brasil | G1
articles.standfirst: A cobrança ocorreu após relatos de usuários de que a inteligência artificial do WhatsApp recusava criar imagens de Lula (PT), mas aceitava de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). O caso fez o TSE cobrar explicações da Meta.
articles.summary: A cobrança ocorreu após relatos de usuários de que a inteligência artificial do WhatsApp recusava criar imagens de Lula (PT), mas aceitava de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). O caso fez o TSE cobrar explicações da Meta.
articles.body:
Especialistas independentes da ONU cobraram nesta quarta-feira (21) que a Meta (dona do Facebook, WhatsApp e Instagram) investigue se seus sistemas de moderação, recomendação e inteligência artificial restringiram de forma desproporcional conteúdos ligados a um dos lados da disputa eleitoral no Brasil.

👉 A manifestação ocorre após relatos de usuários apontarem que a IA do WhatsApp se recusava a criar imagens da campanha de Lula (PT), enquanto aceitava solicitações semelhantes relacionadas a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). O caso levou o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) a cobrar explicações da Meta , que afirmou, na terça-feira (20), ter cumprido as determinações da Corte para garantir tratamento isonômico no 2º turno.

Os observadores da ONU ressaltam que as plataformas online são "atores fundamentais no debate democrático" e que restringir o alcance de determinadas contas afeta o acesso à informação e a liberdade de associação, além de comprometer as próprias eleições.

Segundo os observadores da ONU, entre os incidentes relatados estão:

interrupções temporárias da conta de campanha de um dos candidatos;

diferenças no engajamento do público, nos feeds dos usuários, na contagem de visualizações e no alcance;

restrições a publicações da campanha no Instagram;

e diferenças entre os principais partidos políticos na geração de imagens por IA, nos resultados de busca de canais do WhatsApp, nos Stories dos candidatos e na distribuição de conteúdo político.

"Algoritmos, sistemas de IA e decisões de moderação de conteúdo não devem se tornar árbitros invisíveis da discussão política. Quando a expressão política parecer estar sendo restringida de maneira desproporcional, as plataformas devem explicar o motivo, corrigir impactos desiguais e garantir recursos efetivos", afirmam os especialistas.

Os observadores defendem que a Meta reavalie seus sistemas de moderação, recomendação e IA para verificar se a plataforma restringiu um dos lados da disputa eleitoral de forma desproporcional.

"A democracia e eleições livres e justas dependem de plataformas independentes e consistentes, bem como de um ambiente aberto e pluralista, onde as pessoas possam acessar informações, fiscalizar quem busca o poder, trocar opiniões e se organizar sem interferências arbitrárias”, concluíram os especialistas.

A nota é assinada por nove especialistas independentes em direitos humanos ligados ao Conselho de Direitos Humanos da ONU.

articles.title: VÍDEO: Moradores registram desordem após entrada de indígenas em casa | G1
articles.standfirst: Registro foi feito nessa terça-feira (20), no município de Jordão. Funai informou que tomou conhecimento de relatos e imagens que 'sugerem o ingresso de indígenas isolados'.
articles.summary: Registro foi feito nessa terça-feira (20), no município de Jordão. Funai informou que tomou conhecimento de relatos e imagens que 'sugerem o ingresso de indígenas isolados'.
articles.body:
Um vídeo que circula nas redes sociais mostra uma casa localizada na fazenda Rosa Branca, na Comunidade Santa Cruz, no município do Jordão , no interior do Acre, com objetos jogados para fora da residência e revirados. Imagens mostram indígenas dentro da casa nessa terça-feira (20) . ( Assista acima )

A Fundação Nacional dos Povos Indígenas (Funai) informou, por meio de nota, que 'tomou conhecimento de relatos e imagens que sugerem o ingresso de indígenas isolados ' na região. ( Leia na íntegra no final da reportagem )

Ainda segundo a Funai, as informações e imagens foram repassadas à Coordenação da Frente de Proteção Etnoambiental Envira (CFPE-EVA), que mobiliza uma 'expedição regular de monitoramento territorial na calha do Alto Rio Muru, abrangendo comunidades ribeirinhas situadas no entorno da área' onde vivem os indígenas isolados conhecidos como Cabeludos do Humaitá.

"A equipe da Funai realiza o levantamento de informações com os moradores da área e promove ações de sensibilização sobre as diretrizes protetivas do órgão. Nos próximos dias, os trabalhos de campo concentrarão-se na busca e qualificação de vestígios materiais deixados na localidade e na investigação de possíveis rotas de deslocamento. O procedimento é indispensável para aprimorar as informações sobre a identidade étnica do grupo", diz parte da nota.

Indígenas são flagrados após invadirem casa no interior do Acre — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

A reportagem também entrou em contato com o Distrito Sanitário Especial Indígena (Dsei) Alto Rio Juruá para verificar se os indígenas pertencem a algum povo isolado e foi informada que, embora tenham rumores desta aparição, também tenta confirmar com os órgãos competentes.

“Há rumores de aparição, mas como foi no Jordão, ainda estamos coletando informações. Essa responsabilidade de coleta de dados é da Funai e nós só intervimos quando a saúde é acionada”, informou Júlio Martins, coordenador do distrito.

Ao g1 , Ozenildo Oliveira, proprietário da localidade, disse que a movimentação na propriedade dele foi percebida por meio de câmeras de segurança. Segundo ele, a dinâmica ocorreu por volta das 11h de terça (20).

“Nós estávamos lá em casa e a câmera começou a nos notificar. A gente olhou e era eles [os indígenas] que estavam subindo lá em casa. Aí eles subiram, quebraram a janela, só que a gente não ouviu o barulho da janela. Quando a gente viu, eles estavam jogando as coisas e então nós gritamos. Deu um barulho muito alto nas câmeras, eles soltaram tudo, alguns deles caíram lá embaixo, passaram pelo arame e sumiram na mata”, descreveu.

Dono da propriedade percebeu movimentação por meio de imagens de câmera de segurança — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

Nas imagens, feitas pelo irmão de Ozenildo e outros trabalhadores, é possível verificar o local revirado, além de gritos ao fundo, possivelmente dos indígenas indo embora. Tanto o irmão como os demais homens foram à casa após fazer um trabalho de resgate de um boi na propriedade.

“Demoraram em média uns 35 minutos para desatolar esse boi e quando chegaram já estava tudo espatifado. Só que não tinha como nos comunicarmos com eles porque onde estavam desatolando o boi não tinha sinal [para se comunicar]”, detalhou.

Ozenildo conta que tem a propriedade a seis anos e que esta é a primeira vez que uma situação como essa ocorre. “Hoje [quarta, 21] nós fomos fazer uma vistoria por onde eles tinham corrido, vimos tudo direitinho para onde eles foram embora”, relatou.

Casa está localizada na fazenda Rosa Branca, na comunidade Santa Cruz, no município do Jordão, no interior do Acre — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

A Fundação Nacional dos Povos Indígenas (Funai), por meio da Coordenação da Frente de Proteção Etnoambiental Envira (CFPE-EVA), informa que tomou conhecimento, no dia 20 de outubro, de relatos e imagens que sugerem o ingresso de indígenas isolados na Comunidade Santa Cruz, localizada na zona rural do Município de Jordão (AC).

As informações preliminares foram transmitidas à CFPE-EVA por servidores da Base de Proteção Etnoambiental (BAPE) D’Ouro, vinculada à Unidade Avançada II (Jordão), com base em registros fotográficos e de vídeo capturados por sistemas de monitoramento de propriedades locais.

Diante do ocorrido, a CFPE-EVA mobilizou imediatamente uma equipe do Serviço de Qualificação e Localização (SEQLII). Os servidores já realizavam, desde o dia 14 de outubro, uma expedição regular de monitoramento territorial na calha do alto rio Muru, abrangendo comunidades ribeirinhas situadas no entorno da área de ocupação tradicional da Referência nº 115 (Isolados/Cabeludos do Humaitá).

Essa atividade de rotina busca atualizar dados sobre a dinâmica territorial de povos em isolamento, mapear pressões ou fatores de risco e sensibilizar a população regional sobre a importância de respeitar os limites desses territórios. Com o suporte operacional do Serviço de Proteção Etnoambiental (Seprote) e da Unidade Avançada II, os técnicos deslocaram-se até a localidade para dar início aos protocolos institucionais de acompanhamento.

A equipe da Funai realiza o levantamento de informações com os moradores da área e promove ações de sensibilização sobre as diretrizes protetivas do órgão. Nos próximos dias, os trabalhos de campo concentrarão-se na busca e qualificação de vestígios materiais deixados na localidade e na investigação de possíveis rotas de deslocamento. O procedimento é indispensável para aprimorar as informações sobre a identidade étnica do grupo.

A Funai reafirma seu compromisso com a proteção dos direitos dos povos indígenas isolados e de recente contato. O monitoramento e a vigilância territorial seguem de forma contínua no extenso complexo que abrange as cabeceiras dos rios Tarauacá, Muru e Envira, por meio da atuação conjunta de suas frentes especializadas e das equipes lotadas nas BAPEs das Unidades Avançadas I (Xinane), II (Jordão) e III (Humaitá).

Por fim, o órgão destaca que a política de não contato, o respeito à autodeterminação e a garantia da exclusividade do uso das terras tradicionais permanecem como as principais diretrizes do Estado brasileiro para a salvaguarda dessas populações.

articles.title: Eleitores enfrentam dificuldades para pegar passagens gratuitas no RN | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo a Transpasse, mais de 8 mil passagens foram disponibilizadas, mas bilhetes para quatro destinos estão esgotados; empresas avaliam colocar mais ônibus.
articles.summary: Passagens gratuitas para quatro destinos do RN estão esgotadas antes do segundo turno. Transpasse informa que empresas avaliam disponibilizar mais ônibus.
articles.body:
Filas na Rodoviária de Natal — Foto: Sérgio Henrique Santos/Inter TV Cabugi

Eleitores do Rio Grande do Norte enfrentam dificuldades para conseguir passagens gratuitas para viajar até os municípios onde têm domicílio eleitoral e votar no segundo turno das eleições, marcado para domingo (25). Nesta quarta-feira (21), o terminal rodoviário de Natal registrou filas de pessoas em busca de bilhetes para o deslocamento.

Segundo a Associação das Empresas de Transporte Intermunicipais de Passageiros do RN (Transpasse), mais de 8 mil passagens gratuitas foram disponibilizadas desde segunda-feira (19). Apesar disso, os bilhetes para quatro destinos estão esgotados: Mossoró, Areia Branca, Messias Targino e Apodi.

A falta de passagens levou eleitores a desistirem de viajar para votar. Outros encontraram disponibilidade apenas para horários que consideram arriscados, devido à possibilidade de atrasos durante o trajeto até as cidades onde votam.

A aposentada Maria Célia da Silva tentou emitir passagens para Apodi, mas não conseguiu. "Disseram que não tem mais passagem, que já encerrou, que os carros estão todos cheios. Era para eles botarem carros extras para o pessoal. Quer dizer que vai ficar muita gente sem [ir votar]. Lá em casa são três pessoas sem votar agora no segundo turno".

Mesma situação da agricultora Marineuza Araújo. Moradora de Doutor Severiano, no Alto Oeste do Rio Grande do Norte, ela não sabe se irá conseguir votar no segundo turno. "Disseram que não tinha mais, que não tinha mais passagem, que já estava lotado".

A diretora-geral do Departamento de Estradas de Rodagem do Rio Grande do Norte (DER-RN), Natércia Nunes, afirmou que está em diálogo com as empresas para aumentar o número de passagens e a frota de veículos.

No caso de falta de passagens para determinado destino, a alternativa, acrescenta Nunes, pode ser viajar para uma cidade próxima.

"Caso não haja [passagens] para municípios pequenos como Alexandria, como Marcelino Vieira, você pode ir até Pau dos Ferros, pega um automóvel se locomove e garante o seu direito de voto".

Em nota divulgada nesta quarta-feira, o DER-RN destacou ainda a indisponibilidade de bilhetes gratuitos em algumas cidades, especialmente nas regiões Oeste e Alto Oeste, está relacionada à quantidade de veículos disponibilizados pelas empresas de transporte e pelo sistema alternativo.

O órgão esclareceu que o Decreto Estadual nº 35.957/2026 não estabelece limite para a oferta de bilhetes gratuitos, mas reconheceu a existência de limitações estruturais na frota disponível.

Empresas avaliam disponibilizar mais ônibus

De acordo com a Transpasse, além dos horários regulares, empresas de transporte disponibilizaram ônibus extras para atender à demanda do segundo turno. Mesmo com o reforço, as vagas gratuitas para os quatro destinos foram preenchidas.

O DER-RN informou que mantém contato com empresas e permissionários para tentar ampliar a oferta de veículos e garantir o deslocamento dos eleitores. Até o momento, não há confirmação de que novos ônibus serão disponibilizados para os destinos com passagens esgotadas.

articles.title: Aprenda a fazer o pastel de farinha de milho | G1
articles.standfirst: Prato é reconhecido como patrimônio cultural imaterial de Pouso Alegre, que esta semana completou 178 anos.
articles.summary: Prato é reconhecido como patrimônio cultural imaterial de Pouso Alegre, que esta semana completou 178 anos.
articles.body:
O quadro "Barato da Cozinha", da EPTV Sul de Minas, afiliada da Rede Globo, desta quarta-feira (21) traz um sabor tradicional de Pouso Alegre (MG): o pastel de farinha de milho.

O município completou 178 anos em 19 de outubro. Com presença documentada desde 1928, a receita faz parte da história e da cultura local e foi reconhecida como patrimônio cultural imaterial pelo poder público municipal, com o modo de fazer registrado pelo Decreto nº 3.405/2010, no Livro de Registro dos Saberes.

Em julho de 2026, o pastel de farinha de milho da cidade também foi reconhecido como de relevante interesse cultural do estado de Minas Gerais, por meio da Lei Estadual nº 25.985.

Em Pouso Alegre, o pastel é feito com farinha de milho ao invés de trigo. — Foto: Rafael Smaira/Márcio de Campos

A empresária Josiane Ferreira da Silva tem a receita como tradição na família. Uma tia dela vendeu o pastel por mais de 20 anos em uma feira da cidade.

Josiane aprendeu a fazer o pastel com a mãe dela e fez sucesso em São Paulo com o petisco. De volta a Pouso Alegre, ela fornece a iguaria para bares, restaurantes e buffets.

Ela ensina o passo a passo da receita, que rende cerca de 50 unidades, a um custo estimado de R$ 2 a unidade com recheio de carne moída.

Prepare o recheio refogando a carne e depois, acresentando a batata cozinha cortada em pedaços pequenos.

Misture a farinha de milho, o polvilho azedo e o sal em um recipiente.

Escalde com a água quente e sove até o ponto de abrir a massa.

Abra a massa com a ajuda de um cilindro.

Coloque com o recheio de sua preferência e feche.

articles.title:
Lumiar School amplia sua
proposta educacional com o Toddler | G1
articles.standfirst: A nova série para os pequenos de 1 a 2 anos valoriza os primeiros passos da infância, as descobertas e o respeito ao tempo de cada criança.
articles.summary: A nova série para os pequenos de 1 a 2 anos valoriza os primeiros passos da infância, as descobertas e o respeito ao tempo de cada criança.
articles.body:
Lumiar School amplia sua proposta educacional com o Toddler — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação.

Muito antes de aprender a ler e escrever, a criança já está descobrindo o mundo e desenvolvendo habilidades essenciais para a vida. Nos primeiros anos, cada movimento, interação e descoberta estimula a curiosidade, fortalece vínculos e contribui para o desenvolvimento cognitivo, motor, social e emocional.

É com esse olhar para a primeira infância que a Lumiar School apresenta o Toddler, novo segmento voltado para crianças de 1 a 2 anos. A proposta amplia a experiência educacional da escola, unindo cuidado, acolhimento e oportunidades de aprendizagem desde os primeiros anos de vida.

Uma proposta educacional que considera cada criança

Na Lumiar School, a aprendizagem acontece por meio da participação ativa dos estudantes, da exploração e de experiências significativas. Sua proposta pedagógica combina aprendizagem ativa, currículo em mosaico, gestão participativa e avaliação integrada, valorizando tanto as características e potencialidades de cada criança quanto a construção coletiva do conhecimento, por meio das interações, da colaboração e da troca de experiências.

Com o apoio de tutores e mestres, a escola valoriza os interesses e as descobertas de cada criança, criando oportunidades para desenvolver a autonomia, a curiosidade e novas habilidades.

O início da vida escolar é um momento especial para toda a família. É quando a criança começa a explorar novos ambientes, construir vínculos e ampliar suas experiências para além de casa. No Toddler, essa fase é acolhida com cuidado e intencionalidade. Brincadeiras, interações e descobertas fazem parte de uma proposta que reconhece a primeira infância como um período fundamental para o desenvolvimento.

Mais do que antecipar etapas escolares, a Lumiar School busca proporcionar experiências que despertem o interesse pelo mundo, incentivem a exploração e tornem a aprendizagem parte natural do cotidiano.

Escolher a primeira escola é uma decisão importante, que envolve confiança, acolhimento e identificação com a proposta educacional.

Por isso, conhecer como a escola cuida, acompanha e promove as experiências de aprendizagem das crianças é essencial para que as famílias se sintam seguras nessa escolha.

Com o Toddler, a Lumiar School abre suas portas para receber crianças desde os primeiros anos de vida, fortalecendo seu compromisso com uma educação que valoriza a infância e transforma cada descoberta em uma oportunidade de aprender e se desenvolver.

articles.title: Estudantes de escolas públicas vão conhecer a aviação offshore | G1
articles.standfirst: Iniciativa oferece 350 vagas para alunos de 11 a 14 anos e prevê visitas a aeroportos e heliporto no Rio de Janeiro e no Espírito Santo.
articles.summary: Iniciativa oferece 350 vagas para alunos de 11 a 14 anos e prevê visitas a aeroportos e heliporto no Rio de Janeiro e no Espírito Santo.
articles.body:
Iniciativa da Anac apresenta oportunidades de trabalho na aviação a estudantes — Foto: Ascom Infra

O projeto “Despertar para Profissões – Aviação Offshore”, promovido pela Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Anac), oferece 350 vagas para estudantes de escolas públicas conhecerem a rotina da aviação offshore e os profissionais que atuam no transporte aéreo de passageiros para plataformas de petróleo.

Estão previstas imersões em aeroportos e em um heliporto nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e do Espírito Santo nos dias 26 e 30 de outubro.

A iniciativa é uma parceria da Anac, por meio do programa Asas para Todos, com apoio de empresas que atuam na infraestrutura aeroportuária e na aviação offshore.

Na região, a programação inclui o Aeroporto Internacional de Cabo Frio , no dia 27 de outubro; o Aeroporto de Macaé , no dia 28; e o Heliporto Farol de São Tomé, em Campos dos Goytacazes , no dia 29. A visitação prevê a participação de 350 estudantes com idades entre 11 e 14 anos, matriculados do 6º ao 9º ano do ensino fundamental.

A apresentação dessas funções busca ampliar o conhecimento dos estudantes sobre as possibilidades de formação profissional em um mercado que demanda trabalhadores especializados.

Os alunos terão a oportunidade de conhecer áreas operacionais e acompanhar de perto a rotina de uma atividade ligada à exploração de petróleo e gás em alto-mar.

O projeto também promete apresentar profissões que vão além da pilotagem de aeronaves e mostrar as diferentes funções necessárias para manter as operações em funcionamento.

Projeto abre as portas da aviação offshore para estudantes de escolas públicas — Foto: Ascom Infra

O transporte aéreo por helicópteros é uma das principais formas de deslocamento de trabalhadores entre o continente e as plataformas marítimas de petróleo. As operações exigem uma estrutura que envolve aeroportos, heliportos, manutenção de aeronaves, abastecimento e equipes responsáveis pela segurança e organização dos voos.

A atividade tem relação direta com a economia do Norte Fluminense e da Região dos Lagos. Entre os municípios contemplados estão Macaé, uma das principais bases de apoio às operações de petróleo e gás na Bacia de Campos, e Campos dos Goytacazes, que abriga, em Farol de São Tomé, uma estrutura utilizada no transporte aéreo para unidades marítimas.

Cabo Frio também integra a programação do projeto, com atividades no aeroporto internacional do município.

Além dos pilotos, o setor depende de mecânicos de helicópteros, fiscais de pátio, profissionais responsáveis por orientar a movimentação de aeronaves e administradores encarregados da gestão de aeroportos e heliportos.

Em cada unidade, a programação começa às 13h30, com o credenciamento dos participantes. A partir das 14h, os estudantes terão contato com profissionais de quatro áreas: pilotagem de helicópteros, mecânica de aeronaves, fiscalização de pátio e administração aeroportuária.

Na sequência, está prevista uma visita às áreas operacionais, incluindo pátios de aeronaves, hangares, áreas de abastecimento e vias de taxiamento. Os alunos também poderão conhecer um helicóptero utilizado em operações offshore e conversar com profissionais que atuam no setor.

O encerramento das atividades está previsto para às 16h.

26 de outubro: Aeroporto de Jacarepaguá, no Rio de Janeiro.

27 de outubro: Aeroporto Internacional de Cabo Frio, em Cabo Frio.

28 de outubro: Aeroporto de Macaé, em Macaé.

29 de outubro: Heliporto Farol de São Tomé, em Campos dos Goytacazes.

30 de outubro: Aeroporto de Vitória, no Espírito Santo.

A programação foi organizada para estudantes de escolas públicas com idades entre 11 e 14 anos. O material divulgado pela organização não informa como os 350 participantes serão distribuídos entre os municípios nem esclarece se há possibilidade de inscrição aberta para outros estudantes.

articles.title: Building a Layered Homeland Defense
articles.summary: Modern homeland missile defense requires the ability to detect different threats, understand them quickly and choose the right response. Lockheed Martin experts explain how satellites, radars and interceptors can work together in a layered architecture designed to help operators make faster decisions and defend against evolving threats.
articles.body: Defending the homeland against evolving threats requires more than a single system or solution. In this video, experts from Lockheed Martin share how the company is integrating independent capabilities into a layered defense that connects satellites, radars and interceptor systems. From space-based sensing to proven interceptors like THAAD and PAC-3 MSE, each layer is designed to play a different role in the broader defense architecture. Together, these capabilities are intended to help operators match the right response to the right threat and strengthen the nation’s ability to respond as adversaries develop new technologies.

articles.title: How Qatar, Turkiye, Pakistan and Indonesia are deepening defence ties
articles.summary: Experts say conflicts and uncertainty are accelerating efforts to strengthen regional military capacity.
articles.body:
Qatar, Turkiye, Pakistan and Indonesia signed a deal on Wednesday to deepen their defence industry cooperation, reflecting a broader effort by countries in the region to widen their network of security partners amid the prolonged US-Israel war with Iran.

The four countries signed the memorandum of understanding in Doha, building on existing military projects through joint production, technology transfers and more closely integrated supply chains.

The initiative comes as the failure of the United States and Iran to reach a concrete peace agreement pushes countries in the region to diversify their defence partnerships and look beyond what experts described as an overreliance on Washington for their security. But they stress that closer cooperation does not mean abandoning long-standing alliances. Instead, the ambition is to gain greater control over their own security while strengthening pre-existing partnerships.

Arda Mevlutoglu, a defence industry analyst and managing director of Mergen Analytical Strategies, told Al Jazeera that the implications could extend well beyond the four participants.

“We may be witnessing the emergence of an interconnected network of defence and security arrangements extending from the Gulf to South and Southeast Asia, rather than a single formal alliance,” he said.

In a statement, the Qatari Defence Ministry said the “Badr” Memorandum of Understanding “aims to foster cooperation in the field of defence manufacturing, enhance defence capabilities among the four countries, and promote collaboration in technical defence training, as well as in research and development areas, thereby contributing to the creation of solutions and industries worthy of the evolution of modern defences”.

Experts say that under the agreement, each country will bring its own resources or set of skills to the table. “Turkiye contributes technological expertise, systems integration and a mature defence industry; Pakistan and Indonesia offer manufacturing capacity, skilled workforces and sizeable domestic markets; and Qatar provides investment potential and demand,” said Mevlutoglu.

Together, the four nations could “establish integrated supply chains, allowing these countries to jointly develop, manufacture and sustain defence systems”, he told Al Jazeera.

Such arrangements could give buyers a larger role in producing and supporting their own equipment, while providing manufacturers with longer-term orders and investment. Albert Vidal, a research associate at the International Institute for Strategic Studies, told Al Jazeera that Pakistan and Indonesia were both willing to purchase Turkish weapons and locate part of their production at home.

This could bring down costs for Turkish companies and bring jobs to Pakistan and Indonesia, while Qatar brings “financial depth”, he said.

Turkiye, home to one of the world’s most advanced defence sectors, already has military manufacturing ties with Qatar, Pakistan and Indonesia separately. Qatar and Turkiye, for instance, signed a bilateral defence industry memorandum in October 2025.

But Vidal says that the new agreement, bringing together all four nations, points to a strategic calculation alongside an industrial one. Closer relationships could give more countries a stake in each other’s security. He pointed to Qatar’s investment in the Turkish defence industry over more than a decade and Ankara’s deployment of forces to Doha during the 2017 diplomatic crisis.

Pakistan’s existing naval manufacturing project with Turkiye, meanwhile, shows how weapons purchases can support domestic manufacturing. Of the four ships announced under the project, two are to be built in Istanbul and two at Karachi Shipyard.

Indonesia and Turkiye, meanwhile, are jointly building a tank.

“The rationale is to streamline these distinct defence export and joint production agreements under a more structured and resilient networked hub, rather than reinvent the wheel with each new defence agreement,” Burcu Ozcelik, a senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute, told Al Jazeera.

The US-Israeli war with Iran and recent Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have heightened regional security concerns, analysts say, while reported US weapons shortages may be adding urgency to efforts to strengthen pre-existing partners and bolster domestic arms-building capacity.

“Diversification is a major driver, particularly as recent conflicts have exposed vulnerabilities associated with dependence on foreign suppliers, technology restrictions and supply chain disruptions,” Mevlutoglu said.

But he cautioned against interpreting the memorandum as a break with Washington. “Qatar is unlikely to abandon its strategic relationship with Washington, while Turkiye seeks greater technological independence within NATO, not autonomy from it,” he said.

According to Bader Mousa Al-Saif, an associate fellow with Chatham House’s Middle East and North Africa Programme and an assistant professor at Kuwait University, the initiative reflects Gulf countries increasingly looking towards the Global South and fellow Muslim countries.

It also complements a separate effort to formalise military cooperation across the region, analysts say. Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement in August, establishing a mutual defence commitment. Ankara submitted the agreement to parliament for ratification on Wednesday, although deploying Turkish troops abroad would require separate parliamentary approval.

The Doha memorandum concerns industrial cooperation rather than a mutual defence pledge, but Mevlutoglu sees a connection between the two initiatives. “While Mecca focuses on collective deterrence and military cooperation, Doha could provide the industrial and technological foundations for such partnerships,” he said.

articles.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots for political gain
articles.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.
articles.body:
French President Emmanuel Macron has accused foreign leaders of exploiting the riots which erupted across the country on Saturday for electoral purposes.

Without naming them, he said they were campaigning for forthcoming elections "at France's expense" with their comments on the violence, which erupted on the fringe of cost-of-living protests.

Speaking on a visit to the Middle East, he referred to them as "leaders who are in campaign mode, whether here in the region or on the other side of the Atlantic".

It was an apparent swipe at Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces parliamentary elections next week, and US President Donald Trump, for whom mid-term polls fall next month.

Macron said the unnamed leaders had been influenced by fake videos generated by AI about the riots.

Nearly 150 people have been jailed and more than 800 brought before the courts since the riots which gripped Paris and other cities including Lyon, Marseille and Nice.

Video of running battles between masked rioters and police, as well as property being destroyed and stores being looted, spread across social media.

The government admitted the police had "lost control" during the violence, which came after weeks of protests by students over conditions in high schools.

Macron vowed afterwards that the authorities would be "uncompromising" towards "agitators from ultra-left fringe groups", which he blamed for much of the trouble.

Clean up begins after French riots but police remain

Suspect arrested after historic town hall set alight - French media

Katya Adler: France divided over who to blame for riots and what to learn from them

In pictures: French landmarks damaged and destroyed by violent protesters

Katya Adler: France's government under pressure after weekend of widespread violence

Speaking in the Qatari capital Doha, the French president said: "For me, there is no visible foreign interference in the events that took place. On the other hand, there was foreign manipulation of information afterwards, yes, and that gave rise to unacceptable and stupid comments from many people, including foreign leaders...

"We had people claiming that we had been invaded by hordes of migrants and Islamists, which is completely false."

On Tuesday, Netanyahu said in an interview for Israel's i24 channel that France, which has Western Europe's largest Muslim minority, had been hit by an "invasion of extremist Islam".

He said he had told Macron after the Hamas attack on Israel on 7 October 2023: "If we do not eliminate them here, you will have them in Paris." "That is exactly what is happening," he added.

Also on Tuesday, Trump blamed the riots on mass immigration to France.

"When I look at France, when you look at Italy, when you look at all the turmoil and the hatred, that's not about school," he said. "That's about people coming into the countries that hate the country."

"Close your borders and take control before it is too late!" he said in remarks directed at Macron.

Israel's far right find fertile ground among first-time voters

Analysis: Trump's global headaches worsen weeks before crucial elections

Pink Panther rioting in France is actually AI

According to a report in the UK's Financial Times newspaper , EU regulators are examining possible foreign online interference and disinformation campaigns around the French riots and similar recent outbursts of unrest in EU states.

It quotes unnamed security officials as saying that pro-Russian and far-right social media accounts linked to previous disinformation campaigns have spread violent videos in an attempt to sow more chaos.

Iran and Algeria are also suspected of being behind some of the messaging, the paper adds.

David Colon, a researcher at France's Sciences Po university who specialises in disinformation, was quoted as saying that "pro-Kremlin influencers" linked to the Russian campaign Storm-1516 had "amplified the events and spread a number of false narratives".

France is one of Ukraine's most vociferous military supporters in its ongoing war with Russia, while Algeria is a former French colony with bitter memories of its war to achieve independence in 1962, and French relations with Iran have been strained by its war with the US and Israel this year.

BBC Verify has reviewed more than 15 examples of fake news videos on social media which researchers at the US-based dTeam say are the work of a Russian disinformation operation known as Matryoshka.

The videos feature near-identical branding to real news outlets in France, including Le Monde, Euronews and France 24.

The individual impact and reach of videos made by Matryoshka appear to be limited, but experts have said the focus on amplifying unrest is consistent with known Russian disinformation tactics.

Separately, BBC Verify has traced one of the most viral AI-generated images circulating on social media, which supposedly shows an elderly couple being robbed and left in their underwear in Paris, to an obscure website.

The director of Infos-Israel.News, Sabrina Hania, told the BBC her team had created the image - which was published on 17 October - using ChatGPT without using a reference image.

It was posted shortly after a television journalist reported on the alleged incident, citing "police information". The claim remains unconfirmed, with French media reporting that prosecutors have no information supporting it having happened.

While the original image was labelled as "Made with AI" on X and "AI content" on Instagram, it was later shared on X without any disclaimer in a post which attracted more than six million views.

Hania said she regretted that the image had been taken out of context and had misled so many people, blaming those who reshared it without identifying it as AI-generated.

articles.title: Unknown Canaletto work fetches £135,000 at Oxford auction
articles.summary: The rare work by the revered Venetian artist sold at Mallams auction house in Oxford on Wednesday.
articles.body:
A previously unknown work by the revered Italian artist Canaletto has fetched £135,000 at auction.

The rare artwork, known as a capriccio, more than doubled its estimated price at a sale by Mallams auction house in Oxford earlier.

Canaletto, whose real name was Giovanni Antonio Canal, was born in Venice in 1697 and went on to become a favourite of British art collectors.

Ahead of the auction, Mallams said the artwork had been created by the 18th Century Venetian master with a pen, brown ink and a light grey wash on paper.

It had been expected to sell for between £40,000 and £60,000.

Art historian John Rolfe said the Canaletto work, Ruins of a Pavilion and an Arcade over the Water, was a "masterpiece".

He said it depicted "architectural splendours of the past in ruins" where "everyday life goes on amidst the shadows and sunlight".

Canaletto was a member of the Venetian art school, and was best known across Europe for his cityscapes depicting Venice and London.

But in his home country, his capriccios - fanciful imaginary scenes, often showing classical ruins - were held in higher esteem, Mallams said.

It said the previously unrecorded work corresponded with a Canaletto painting which was last sold at Christie's in 1995.

The work is thought to have been acquired by the Georgian composer and musician Charles Burney, and has been kept in the family since, the auction house said.

An inscription on the back of the work reads "a Present from Sig Canal d Canaletti", suggesting the artists had once given the work to someone as a gift.

Rupert Fogden, Mallams' director of fine art and pictures, previously said the auction house was "truly delighted to be entrusted" with the sale.

articles.title: Jeffrey Donaldson to be interviewed over alleged rape inside Houses of Parliament
articles.summary: While not naming the disgraced former MP, the Metropolitan Police has issued a statement confirming a 63-year-old man is being investigated.
articles.body:
Jailed former Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) leader Jeffrey Donaldson is being investigated by London police about an alleged rape of a woman inside the Houses of Parliament, the BBC can reveal.

The disgraced former MP has been accused of raping the woman in Parliament in 2016, at the very heart of the political establishment.

Last week Donaldson was sentenced to 15 years in prison for a series of child sex offences against two victims, including one count of rape, which took place between 1985 and 2008. He is seeking to appeal against his convictions.

It is understood the woman has been interviewed by Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) officers.

The PSNI has now shared her claims with the Metropolitan Police, as the alleged incident happened in London.

While not naming the former DUP leader, the Met has issued a statement confirming a 63-year-old man is being investigated.

It said: "On Tuesday 13 October, the Met received a report referred to us by the Police Service of Northern Ireland relating to an allegation of rape in 2016, by a man now aged 63.

"The allegation relates to one victim who is being supported by specialist officers.

"The investigation is in its early stages. No arrests have been made and enquiries are ongoing."

In July, the Belfast Telegraph first reported that a woman from Northern Ireland alleged she had been sexually assaulted by Donaldson in the DUP offices at Parliament in 2016.

She claimed that he attempted to get her to drink vodka shots in his office, before trying to kiss her and put his hand up her skirt.

On Saturday, the newspaper further reported that the Met was set to investigate and interview Donaldson about these accusations.

But in response to BBC questions it has now emerged the same woman has also alleged Donaldson raped her.

Concerns about the ex-DUP MP's behaviour in London was raised in a BBC NI Spotlight film , earlier this year.

A former senior PSNI detective told the programme he had seen Donaldson drunk in the Houses of Parliament.

Two other former senior PSNI detectives also reported seeing him going into a gay sauna not far from Parliament in 2006, the same year in which Donaldson described homosexuality as "sinful".

articles.title: US congressional candidate Brad Lander detained in West Bank
articles.summary: Lander was freed, but says dozens remain in Israeli custody.
articles.body:
United States Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander says he has been released from Israeli military custody with a warning after being detained alongside dozens of volunteers helping Palestinian farmers harvest olives in the occupied West Bank.

But several dozen others, including rabbis and international volunteers, remain in detention, according to Lander, who called for them to be released immediately after the incident Wednesday.

“I’ve been released from [Israeli army] custody with a ‘warning,’ apparently because of my public profile,” Lander wrote on X. “I told them I wasn’t even a congressmember yet, just a nominee.”

Lander, a Jewish American and former New York City comptroller, was among approximately 80 volunteers detained by Israeli soldiers and police near the village of Nahalin, outside Bethlehem, according to the Israeli organisation Rabbis for Human Rights.

The group included American, Israeli, Palestinian, British and Canadian volunteers.

Becca Strober, a representative of the Protect the Harvest Coalition, which helped organise the olive harvest, told Al Jazeera that the group had been picking olives at the invitation of a Palestinian family for several hours when the Israeli army arrived.

“It was a nice, peaceful day,” he said. “There was no conflict. There was no settler violence. There was no violence of any kind.”

According to Strober, after a while, soldiers began checking the volunteers’ IDs, and soon after, issued an order declaring the area a closed military zone. They then detained the group, first in the field and later at a police station.

“To this moment, everyone’s still detained except for Brad Lander,” said Strober. “They very clearly told him that they allowed him to be released because he’s likely to be in Congress very soon.”

Israel’s Foreign Ministry, meanwhile, accused Lander of staging a “calculated political provocation,” alleging that he’d deliberately entered a restricted security area without approval.

“This was not about harvesting olives. It was about harvesting headlines,” the ministry said in a statement on X, alleging that Lander’s team and reached out to Israeli representatives in the US in advance of the visit and had been told it would require coordination with relevant authorities, but that Lander ignored those instructions.

“Brad Lander came looking for a confrontation,” said the statement. “Now he is pretending to be its victim.”

Anton Goodman, acting director for Rabbis for Human Rights, told Reuters that volunteers who were neither Israeli nor Palestinian citizens were expected to be transferred to an Israeli military base.

In a video posted on X from one of the buses, Lander said Israeli forces had detained the group after apparently being called to the area by settlement security personnel.

“We’ve been detained by the Israeli military for harvesting olives,” he said. “And let’s be clear, occupation is a crime under international law. Harvesting olives is not a crime under any law.”

It’s not clear why the area was declared a closed military zone. Rabbis for Human Rights said the olive pickers had no way of knowing about the order and had offered to leave voluntarily when they were told.

Lander said the volunteers had been taken away for processing, but had not been told whether they were under arrest.

Lander, a vocal critic of Israel’s war on Gaza, is a former New York City mayoral candidate and an ally of Mayor Zohran Mamdani. He’s now running as the Democratic nominee for New York’s 10th Congressional District in the US’s November 3 midterm elections.

Writing on X after his release, Lander said Palestinians face worse consequences every day.

“These detentions by the [Israeli army] are one more attempt to undermine Palestinians’ right to harvest their olive groves, travel on their roads, and live in their homes,” he wrote. “Yet one more element of escalating, and very clearly state-sponsored, ethnic cleansing.”

Neither the Israeli government nor the US Embassy in Jerusalem immediately responded to a request for comment.

The volunteers had travelled to the West Bank to support Palestinian farmers during the annual olive harvest, amid a surge in settler violence, including several attacks in recent days targeting Palestinians and international observers.

Strober said Wednesday was the first time the Palestinian family picking olives had been able to access its own land since October 7, 2023 because violence in the area had made it too dangerous to return.

“The fact that Brad was there, of course, made the situation more newsworthy, but we’ve been seeing this happen in the West Bank for years,” she said.

On Friday, an American photojournalist working for The Washington Post was beaten by Israeli settlers while covering the olive harvest. The following day, European diplomats and a French mayor were attacked by settlers during another harvest. Palestinians were also attacked in both incidents.

Israeli police said on Tuesday that they had arrested 10 people in connection with the attacks.

articles.title: Witkoff faces backlash after calling Putin a ‘humanitarian’
articles.summary: Special envoy Steve Witkoff is facing criticism from lawmakers after calling Russian President Vladimir Putin a “humanitarian” for releasing an American who has been held in Russia for years. President Trump had made a direct appeal to Putin for the release of Stephen Hubbard, a teacher who was accused of being a Ukrainian mercenary. Hubbard…
articles.body:
Special envoy Steve Witkoff is facing criticism from lawmakers after calling Russian President Vladimir Putin a “humanitarian” for releasing an American who has been held in Russia for years.

President Trump had made a direct appeal to Putin for the release of Stephen Hubbard, a teacher who was accused of being a Ukrainian mercenary. Hubbard was released Wednesday after more than four years in detention.

“You talk so much about my president, President Trump, being a humanitarian,” Witkoff, in St. Petersburg, Russia, said to Putin. “You are a humanitarian also, sir, and I salute that.”

Sen. Thom Tillis (R-N.C.) hit Witkoff in a Wednesday post on the social platform X, saying, “WTF, Steve?”

“Look up the definition of ‘humanitarian.’ What an embarrassing and outrageous thing to say,” he wrote . “You should go back to Ukraine and ask the families of the children Putin has kidnapped and murdered whether they agree your friend Putin is a ‘humanitarian.’”

Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas) rebutted Witkoff’s comments.

“No. Putin is stone cold killer,” he wrote on X .

And Rep. Don Bacon (R-Neb.) called it “another embarrassment.”

Witkoff was in St. Petersburg to discuss the Russia-Ukraine war, a day after meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Oslo.

Putin agreed Wednesday to resume trilateral talks “in principle” with Washington and Ukraine, The Associated Press reported. They would resume after Nov. 10.

articles.title: Russia releases American Stephen Hubbard after four years in prison
articles.summary: Hubbard was jailed after being accused of fighting alongside Ukrainian forces against Russia.
articles.body:
American Stephen Hubbard has been freed from a Russian prison and is on his way home after United States President Donald Trump said his administration had secured his release.

“Stephen is on his way back home and will soon be with his family,” Trump wrote in a social media post on Wednesday, adding that the US was not required to give anything in return for the release of the 74-year-old former teacher from Michigan.

The deal came during a visit to Russia by a top US envoy, and just days after Trump took a series of actions seen as beneficial to Moscow.

Hubbard, whose family says had been living in Ukraine since before Russia launched its full-scale invasion in 2022, was tried and convicted in a closed-door trial, with Russian prosecutors saying he had signed a contract with the Ukrainian military and had fought alongside its forces before being captured. He was sentenced to seven years in prison in 2024.

The US had declared Hubbard a wrongfully detained American.

Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff, who is in Russia for talks with President Vladimir Putin on the Ukraine war, told him that “our whole nation sends their thanks” and that Putin was a “humanitarian” for allowing Hubbard to walk free. Witkoff briefly met with Hubbard in St. Petersburg after his release, telling him, “from today is a new life for you”.

The release came at a dynamic moment in relations between the US, Ukraine and Russia, with the Washington-Kyiv relationship under strain at the same time that the Trump administration has pursued policies which Ukraine says have rewarded Putin.

Those include Trump’s decision last week to waive sanctions on Russia imposed by a bill that the US Congress overwhelmingly passed to support Ukraine.

Named after the late South Carolina Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, the legislation targeted the flow of financial resources fuelling Moscow’s war on Ukraine.

That reversal followed Trump’s announcement of a deal to import Russian diesel fuel in an effort to curb high gas prices before next month’s US midterm elections.

articles.title: Sinkhole revealed 50 metre deep mine shaft uneder road
articles.summary: Part of Alan Turing Way has been closed since March and is expected to stay shut until mid-December.
articles.body:
Work is taking place to repair a sinkhole which revealed a 50m (164ft) mine shaft under a busy road in east Manchester.

Part of the northbound carriageway on Alan Turing Way has been closed since March, when the road surface began to sink.

Since then, Manchester City Council has filled the hole with more than 100 tonnes of concrete.

It said it expected the route to be open again December.

Mandie Shilton Godwin, the executive member for transport, said it had been a "massive job", adding it had "taken an awfully long time”.

She added: "It started in March when the depression was noticed, but it wasn't until the end of September when the team were absolutely sure what the problem was.

"Once they were sure what the problem was, then they could begin to put it right.

"No one could have anticipated the scale of the void that we found but, once it became apparent, all of our effort went into making sure the site was safe and the road could be reopened."

A concrete cap is currently being put over the mine shaft.

Work will then need to take place to fill the remaining void beneath the road, and lay a new surface.

articles.body: A Hollywood home can have a life of its own, changing hands as its owners move through different chapters of their careers. In Toluca Lake, a charming Los Angeles property once owned by Kirsten Dunst has found a new custodian in fellow actress Annie Potts. With its leafy outdoor spaces, inviting interiors and private waterfront setting, the five-bedroom home sold for $4.55 million, keeping the property firmly within Hollywood circles, states an online report by The Los Angeles Times.A swift sale in Toluca LakeAs per The Los Angeles Times report, Dunst purchased the 4,333-square-foot residence in 2001 for $2.6 million. Eighteen years later, the property attracted a buyer just nine days after hitting the market in June, initially listed at $4.7 million. Potts, best known for her roles in the original Ghostbusters films, ultimately secured the home for $4.55 million.The sale highlights the enduring appeal of Toluca Lake, a neighbourhood popular with entertainment-industry figures for its residential charm and proximity to Hollywood and major studio facilities. Yet it is the property's combination of indoor comfort and carefully designed outdoor spaces that gives it much of its character, states another report by the Observer.Light-filled interiors with artistic touchesAs per the LA Times report, inside, the home favours a bright, understated palette. White walls, light hardwood flooring and generous windows create an airy backdrop, while the living room's fireplace brings warmth to the main gathering space. The dining area is crowned by a chandelier, and the kitchen features marble surfaces and a central island designed for both cooking and entertaining.Across its 4,333 square feet, the house accommodates five bedrooms and four-and-a-half bathrooms, balancing generous family spaces with quieter corners that make the most of its setting, adds the report.A garden that leads to the waterA white picket fence frames the front lawn, where a fountain provides a welcoming focal point. At the rear, the garden unfolds across a series of tiered patios that lead towards a private dock on the lake. The waterfront setting gives the property a distinctly relaxed atmosphere, offering a retreat from the pace of Los Angeles, states the online report.The outdoor entertaining areas are equally considered. French doors connect the family room to a brick patio featuring a custom-built gazebo, an outdoor kitchen and a dining area. A fire pit provides a natural gathering spot, while steps descend to another patio with a swimming pool and spa. Overlooking the pool is a crescent-moon art installation, adding an unexpected sculptural detail to the landscape, explains The LA Times report.Two actresses, two Hollywood chaptersAccording to The Los Angeles Times report, Dunst built an impressive career from childhood, earning a Golden Globe nomination at just 12 for Interview with the Vampire. Her later credits include The Virgin Suicides, Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, Melancholia and Sam Raimi's Spider-Man trilogy.Potts, meanwhile, earned a Golden Globe nomination for Corvette Summer in 1978 and went on to star in Pretty in Pink, Jumpin' Jack Flash and Designing Women, also claims the report. The purchase follows several property moves for Potts, who sold a colourful Toluca Lake hacienda for $3.875 million three years ago and a Midcentury Modern-style home in Sherman Oaks for $1.84 million earlier this year, adds the online report.Now, the lakefront residence begins another chapter, with its blend of classic interiors, resort-style outdoor living and waterside tranquillity continuing to draw interest beyond its former owner's Hollywood legacy.Images Courtesy: Wikipedia, istock, and InstagramReady to Make a Smarter Property Decision?
